attempts.summary: Configured secure, persistent rsyslog forwarding of node2 messages tagged `inventory` to node1 over TCP 5514. Messages are stored at `/var/log/inventory/node2.log`. The flow and existing data survived sequential OS restarts of both nodes. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged; SELinux remains enforcing.
